newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil extends losses at close.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil extends losses at close.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices closed lower, extending Wednesday's losses on dealers' selling, as sentiment remained influenced by a strong ringgit. Lower-than-expected Jan 1-15 exports also weakened sentiment. March futures support is seen at 1,255 with resistance at 1,285. Trading remained volatile.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Interest was scattered and dealing cautious. Some business seen among products.
Some traders expected the market to soften because of the bearish palm oil export data and lack of support, while others felt that prices should rebound after the recent retracement.
The bullish end-December stock level, released by PORLA on Wedneday, failed to boost sentiment, they said.

Malaysia's Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) said end-December stocks fell 17.08 percent to 792,687 tonnes from end-November, but players were concerned about the large local disappearance as exports were not very good.
"Market sentiment was also dragged down by a prevailing strong ringgit against the dollar," a trader said. "This means that it is more expensive for the buyers to buy."

Traders said if the ringgit continues to strengthen, exports are likely to be affected in the long term as products would be Most active March futures contract fell 24 ringgit to 1,268 ringgit ($511.49) a tonne and new third month trading month April futures closed 17 ringgit down at 1,261 ringgit.
Physical Jan (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,347.50 ringgit against bids at 1,340, after trading at 1,347.50.
Jan (central) was offered at 1,325 and bids at 1,315, and Jan (north) at 1,300 against 1,295 with earlier trades at 1,300.
Feb (south) saw offers at 1,345 with bids at 1,337.50 and Feb (central) at 1,325 against 1,315.
Among refined products, Jan RBD palm oil was offered at $565 a tonne FOB Malaysia and Feb/Mar at $560. Feb was traded at $565.
Jan RBD palm olein saw offers at $595, Feb at $592.50 and Mar at $582.50. Feb was traded at $592.50 and Mar at $582.50.
Feb/Mar RBD palm stearin was offered at $432.50 and Feb/Mar palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $300.
